glance.what: Aniko is a complete and highly effective SAT prep platform, designed like an engaging game where the goal is to raise your score. Underneath, an accurate system knows exactly how to get you there — so effective that your score increase is guaranteed.

bullets.text: Aniko is a complete and highly effective SAT prep platform, designed like an engaging game where the goal is to raise your score. Underneath, an accurate system knows exactly how to get you there — so effective that your score increase is guaranteed.
赛道：教育；客群：个人用户。
公开 MRR US$26.0K，近 30 天收入 None。
商业模式：免费增值 + 订阅。
流量渠道全景待补充：需 Similarweb/公开流量估算核实。
官网标题：Your SAT Score, Guaranteed | Aniko。
内容 SEO：官网维护博客/更新日志（https://aniko.ai/blog），是可核实的自有内容渠道。
按 MRR 年化运行率约 US$312.0K。
具体增长打法待补充：需社媒/目录公开内容核实。
官网公开社媒入口：Reddit r/AnikoStudents。
官网博客/更新日志公开条目（页面未标注日期）：Free Question Bank、Math、Reading & Writing。
存在免费层：优化 free→paid 转化触发点（用量上限/高级功能墙），避免免费层过度消耗成本。
赛道打法参考：教育类靠教程视频 + 创作者联盟。
同赛道已有多个公开收入样本，先在项目库横向对比定价与收入结构再切入。
